content: RAI ROS2 tools (rai.tools.ros2, rai_core) all inherit BaseROS2Tool, constructed with a ROS2Connector plus readable/writable/forbidden allow-lists of topic/service/action names -- an explicit permission gate per tool instance. Examples: GetROS2TopicsNamesAndTypesTool (introspection), GetROS2ImageTool (subscribes to an image topic, converts to a VLM-consumable format), PublishROS2MessageTool (generic publish, e.g. to /to_human or /cmd_vel), CallROS2Service, GetROS2LidarDataTool (PointCloud2), GetDistanceToObjects (camera+depth spatial query), NavigateToPose-style Nav2 action tool. Source: robotecai.github.io/rai/tutorials/tools/.
